title: Snapshot carousel: per-model insight strip with latency/throughput/token mini-charts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and prototype a compact 'snapshot carousel' component for the Console that surfaces per-model and per-route performance insights. The carousel is a horizontal scroller of discrete model tiles (snapshot cards) designed for quick triage: each tile contains micro-charts for median/95p latency (latency envelope), throughput ridgeline (requests/sec), and token-cost ribbon (tokens per response + estimated cost). This is intended as a lightweight, one-line overview that supports quick comparisons across models and routes and acts as an entrypoint to the full model performance panel. Goals: 1) let engineers quickly spot regressions and cost anomalies; 2) enable keyboard & screen-reader friendly navigation; 3) minimize visual noise while preserving fidelity of distributional signals; 4) allow rollouts/variant badges (canary/stable) and quick actions (open route, open model, start investigation).
acceptance_criteria: Carousel renders up to 20 model tiles in a single horizontal band and paginates beyond that
Each tile shows: micro-latency envelope (median + 95p), throughput ridgeline, and token-cost ribbon with baseline and anomaly marker
Hover exposes tooltip with exact numeric aggregates and last-24h sparkline; clicking tile opens detailed model performance panel
Keyboard navigation (left/right) traverses tiles; Enter opens detail; screen reader exposes tile summary text
Rollout badges (canary/stable/paused) displayed and clicking badge reveals rollout controls in Console
Color choices meet WCAG AA contrast for key text and status indicators; visual density adjustable in user settings

decisions: Use a single composite band per tile (compact band with 3 micro-charts) instead of stacked heavy charts
Show 50 tiles by default with virtualization and an option to 'show all' that triggers progressive load
Display 95p latency and median; exclude max to avoid noise from outliers
Integrate rollout state badges into tile header; clicking badge opens existing rollout panel (no new API needed)
Implement patterned fills for alert overlays to ensure colorblind-safe indication
mock_review_outcomes: PM feedback: Good tradeoff between compactness and signal — asked to surface recent regressions with an inline red caret
Eng feedback: Virtualization + progressive fetch required for large orgs; front-end spike validated the approach on Chrome/Edge
SRE feedback: Add 'data freshness' microdot in top-right of tile to avoid stale-metrics confusion
Design review: Tone down saturation on throughput gradient; use monotone palette for ridgeline to reduce visual competition with cost ribbon
